title: Boots’ owner Sycamore Partners allegedly nears sale of UK retailer to Weston family
summary: Sycamore Partners is rumoured to be in conversations with the billionaire Weston family, a Canadian-British business group, in negotiating a sale of the UK health and beauty retailer, according to a new report

extraction.key_fact: 영국 헬스 앤 뷰티 리테일러 부츠의 소유주 시카모어 파트너스가 웨스턴 가문에 매각을 협상 중이라는 보도가 나왔다.
